# xbid.live

> xbid.live is a live two-sided onchain contest market built by WEconomy Labs and currently running on Robinhood Chain Testnet.

XBID lets users buy a side token, sell a position, or atomically flip from one side to the other. Prices and control move continuously with confirmed onchain trading. XBID is not a binary prediction market that waits for an external event result; users enter and exit against the live market curve.

Core facts:
- Network: Robinhood Chain Testnet, chain ID 46630.
- Settlement token: Test USDC with 6 decimals and no monetary value.
- Trading fee: 1% of the trade amount, rounded up to the smallest Test USDC unit.
- Current fee split: 70% protocol, 20% contest creator, 10% bound referrer. Without a referrer, the unused share goes to the protocol.
- Contest creation fee: 5 Test USDC.
- Market versions: V1 keeps b=270,000; new V2 contests use b=150,000. Existing contests never change curve version.
- Crown: activates after 70,000 Test USDC of curve reserve; a challenger opens at 48% control and takes the crown after maintaining at least 52% for 60 seconds.
- Testnet use carries smart-contract, liquidity, wallet and market risk. Returns are not guaranteed.

Primary pages:
- /how-it-works — product walkthrough and frequently asked questions.
- /docs — trading, fees, crown, referral, launch and safety rules.
- / — live contest discovery.
- /launch — create a two-sided contest.
